name: Poonawalla Fincorp Ltd
about: Poonawalla Fincorp Limited (erstwhile Magma Fincorp Limited) is a non-deposit taking NBFC registered with RBI. It is engaged in providing consumer and MSME financing, as well as General Insurance services. [1][2]
keyPoints: Promoter:[1] [2] As of April 2026, the Cyrus Poonawalla group holds a 59% stake in the company through Rising Sun Holdings Private Limited. The Group has diversified business interests in the Pharmaceuticals & Biotechnology, Finance, Clean Energy, Hospitality & Realty, and Aviation.
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 3.16 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 5.94% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 3.05% of profits over last 3 years
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.09%
